lokal-music.description:
Your music, your files, a modern player. Now on Android. Lokal Mobile brings the artwork-led library, personal mixes and synced lyrics of Lokal desktop to your pocket. Play the collection you already own, discover something new through sources you choose, and keep your phone and desktop connected.

No Lokal account is needed to play local files. Your library and listening history live on your device; online discovery, lyrics, artwork and account integrations are optional.
